title: Cross-stitch saying: a cat can have kittens in an oven, but that don't make them biscuits
summary: A humorous folk saying shown as a cross-stitch sampler with two Stars of David: “A cat can have kittens in an oven, but that don't make them biscuits” — being born somewhere does not change what you are.

text.text: A cat can have kittens in an oven, but that don't make them biscuits.

pictures.description: Cross-stitch sampler on pale yellow fabric with a blue and yellow stitched border; the saying is stitched in red cross-stitch letters, with two light-blue Stars of David on either side of the last word.
pictures.text_in_picture: A cat can have kittens in an oven, but that don't make them biscuits.

keywords: birthplace doesn't change what you are
